metadata.description: The result each query of the updated catalogue is expected to give on its live target endpoint, with every check behind it: the automated HTTP checks (verify runs), the runs by hand and single requests made while updating the catalogue, and counts computed from aggregate queries. Counts are snapshots from November 2026: the endpoints' data change, so later counts can differ.
metadata.expectedRule: expected.outcome is ok (with resultCount) when a check of the current query text returned results; the latest such check is used. Otherwise, a count computed from aggregate queries is used (observed: false); if the query errored when it was run, runError says why and runErrorBasis names those checks. Otherwise, the latest check decides: empty (0 rows) or fails, with the reason in failure. basis names the check(s) used.

fields.queryHash: sha256(target + NUL + query)[:16] of the catalogue entry; a check applies to the query text with this hash
fields.checks: checks of the current query text, oldest first
fields.otherVersions: checks of other versions: earlier texts in the updated catalogue, upstream versions (upstreamFile at sparql-examples@45e5b53) and variants (text in query, or described in versionNote)
fields.method: http-check (run = verify run, see the catalogue's metadata.verificationRuns), by-hand (result = what the person wrote down), probe (one HTTP request), computed
fields.outcome: ok, empty, error, timeout or too-large for checks; ok, empty, fails, too-large or unknown for expected
